<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Since c048ebc2 (2026-08-30, rs cutover) every omp/pi seat boots pij-blind: PijSession.boot injects announceText only when `fresh = registry.read(id)===null || dissolved`, and RustRuntimeSession.boot seeds every rs seat row (never reaped) into that registry BEFORE calling session.boot — so the chosen id always pre-exists (spawn pre-mints it; hand-started seats reuse by pane/process/PIJ_SESSION_ID). Last announce on disk: 2026-08-28. Live proof + mechanism: assets/inputs/diagnosis-2026-09-05.md. Fix: the daemon is the only party that knows whether /v1/register CREATED a row, RE-BOUND an existing id to a new process, or refreshed the same process; it returns that as an additive `binding` field, the TS client passes it through, and PijSession.boot accepts an explicit `fresh` override. Legacy path untouched.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A spawned omp seat (pij-rs spawn --harness omp --bin omp) receives announceText as its first injected turn.
- A hand-started omp seat that reuses its id (same pane / same PIJ_SESSION_ID) still announces on the first session_start of a NEW process.
- /new, /fork, reload on a live seat do not announce twice (the original 'exactly one inject at boot' rule survives).
- The rs register contract carries the fact additively (`binding: created|rebound|same`), shared by both runtimes through one golden fixture.
- One wire frame across harnesses: an omp/pi seat renders an inbound peer message exactly as the daemon frames it for a Claude seat.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Reaping or tombstoning stale rs seat rows (separate roadmap question, plan 095 evidence pointer).
- announceText content and the ready-ping protocol (PIJ_ANNOUNCE_TO path) stay unchanged, EXCEPT the one sentence describing the inbound frame, which must describe the frame we actually emit (amended by prime ruling 2026-09-05 when AC8 landed: a boot message documenting the legacy shape teaches every fresh seat to expect the generation it is not on).
- Any legacy-daemon behaviour; the legacy TS daemon is stopped for good.
